title: FAIR Metadata Check (Extended)
description: Evaluates metadata quality of digital repositories against the FAIR Principles. Connects to OAI-PMH endpoints, DataCite records, or one of several supported REST APIs (STAC, CKAN, Dataverse, CSW and others), harvests metadata, and runs a structured assessment across 14 sub-principles.

title: After Retraction
description: Retraction analysis: citation persistence, detection patterns, infrastructure gaps.

title: Debris with DOIs
description: Problematic files with DOIs: OS artifacts, security risks, and dev debris in DataCite repositories, mapped by country.

title: Publisher Gap
description: Metadata completeness of journal articles, 2015-2025: what publishers deposit in Crossref compared with what OpenAlex records.

title: ORCID Membership
description: Completeness of the public ORCID profiles found through the ROR ids of 120 research institutions, 20 per continent, compared between ORCID members and other institutions, by year of account creation and by who wrote each entry.

title: Research Assessment Reform Toolkit
description: Tools for putting research assessment reform into practice at an institution: diagnose maturity on CoARA's ten commitments, draft an action plan and track progress. The researcher profile is open; the other tools ask for an access key.

title: Researcher Narrative Profile
description: Enter an ORCID iD and get a narrative profile of a researcher, written by fixed rules from public records in ORCID, OpenAlex, DataCite, Crossref and GitHub, not by an AI model. Every paragraph names its sources, and it exports as schema.org JSON-LD.

title: SciELO Chile in Crossref
description: Crossref metadata completeness for SciELO Chile journals.

title: Beyond Articles
description: Metadata completeness of Chilean research outputs other than articles (datasets, images, collections, software, data management plans and models) in DataCite and ANID's repository: where they are deposited, under which licence, and how completely they are described.

title: Austria: research metadata audit
description: Metadata completeness and FAIR scores of repositories registered at DataCite by Austrian members, and completeness of ORCID profiles affiliated with Austrian research institutions.

title: Netherlands: research metadata audit
description: Metadata completeness and FAIR scores of repositories registered at DataCite by Dutch members, and completeness of ORCID profiles affiliated with Dutch research institutions.

title: FAIR Metadata Check
description: Score the FAIR metadata quality of any DataCite or OAI-PMH repository, entirely in your browser: live harvest, 14 sub-principles, nothing uploaded. A browser version of FAIR Metadata Check (Extended), with its code published.

title: ORCID Affiliation Finder
description: Find the ORCID accounts that declare an institution, narrow them by keyword, role, department, country and dates, and export the table. Runs in the browser against the public ORCID and ROR APIs.

title: Research Assessment Reform Planner
description: Self-assess your institution against the ten CoARA commitments and get a prioritised, editable reform action plan. Everything runs in your browser.

title: Actionable DMP
description: Write a data management plan as a machine-actionable file (RDA DMP Common Standard v1.2), answering the fifteen questions of Science Europe's core requirements, and check what it says about each dataset against its DOI record in DataCite.

title: Value of Open Research Information
description: Draft for the Barcelona Declaration, Working Group 7, Task Force 2: the nine transformative benefits of open research information, as an interactive explorer.
